## Energy use and running costs

A commercial freezer runs all day, so energy use adds up over the years. Compare the stated power consumption, check the quality of the insulation and the door seals, and avoid placing the unit next to heat sources. A well-sited unit with clean coils runs more efficiently and keeps stock at a steady temperature. When you compare models, look at the cost over several years rather than the purchase price alone.

## Delivery and installation

Measure the doorway, the route and the final spot, and confirm the power supply suits the unit. Large upright freezers may need to be moved on a trolley, and some venues need a tail-lift delivery. Our [delivery information](/delivery/) explains how orders reach you.
